answer: Mechanism: per-identity stake + slashing. Before voting or grading, every identity must deposit 75 USDC into the slashing escrow, complete a Zephyr RTOS-measured boot attestation, send a Whisper-encrypted liveness challenge, and bind a Willow-chip hardware key to that deposit. A farm of 1000 clones pays 75,000 USDC in stake and loses it all the moment audit detects a shared Zephyr boot hash across the clone pattern. Honesty stays cheaper.
